claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: RWJ-21757 is a TLR7 agonist guanosine analog that at 2.5 uM is expected to produce little direct cytotoxicity, with any killing likely reflecting weak nucleoside-analog antimetabolite/DNA-synthesis inhibition rather than TLR7-driven immune activation in this pooled tumor-cell screen.
